jobs.title: Open Source Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub


✏️ What you will do

As an Open Source Engineer at NetBird, you’ll focus on building and shipping features for the open source community, especially homelabbers, self-hosters, and technical power users. This is a hands-on, builder role. You’ll spend most of your time writing code, talking to the community and experimenting features that make NetBird more useful, flexible, and fun to run in real-world setups.

You will:

  • Build and ship open source features used by homelabbers and self-hosters.

  • Work across the stack to improve self-hosting, local deployments and community-driven use cases.

  • Pick up ideas directly from GitHub issues, discussions, and community feedback and turn them into working code.

  • Improve developer experience, docs, examples and setup flows for OSS users.

  • Review and collaborate on community pull requests as a peer, not a gatekeeper.

  • Maintain and improve tooling around local dev, Docker, Kubernetes, and self-hosted environments.

  • Experiment with new ideas, integrations, and workflows that make NetBird easier to hack on.

  • Help keep NetBird approachable, hackable, and fun for contributors.

 

🔎 What we are looking for

We’re looking for an Open Source Engineer who combines deep technical leadership with a passion for open source collaboration.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, with strong full-stack capabilities.

  • Experience building, maintaining, or leading open source projects.

  • Proven experience leading technical initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of backend systems, APIs, and distributed architectures.

  • Experience with frontend technologies and developer-facing UIs.

  • Ability to make and communicate architectural and technical decisions.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Experience with Go, TypeScript, React, or similar modern stacks.

  • Strong experience with unit and integration testing principles.

  • A community-first mindset and belief in open development.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Familiarity with networking, security, or Zero Trust architectures.

  • Experience managing roadmaps and technical direction.

  • Public GitHub profile with meaningful contributions.

  • Experience growing developer communities.

 

😌 What’s in for you

We want you to do meaningful work and be proud of what you build.

That’s why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation with salary and equity.

  • Hybrid work model between our Berlin office and remote.

  • High-impact role shaping both product and community.

  • Real technical ownership of a global open source platform.

  • Direct influence on NetBird’s architecture and roadmap.

  • A strong engineering culture built around transparency and collaboration.

  • Career growth as NetBird becomes a leading open source security company.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub


✏️ What you will do

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will play a key role in building and scaling the infrastructure behind NetBird’s global networking platform. You’ll ensure our systems are reliable, secure, and performant while enabling engineers to ship quickly and confidently.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, networking, and backend systems. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to design and operate the platform that powers secure, peer-to-peer connectivity for users around the world. Specifically, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate scalable cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code for NetBird's globally distributed management and relay services.

  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support rapid, reproducible, and safe delivery of backend and client components.

  • Own service reliability: implement observability (metrics, logs, tracing), lead incident response, and drive postmortems with actionable improvements.

  • Collaborate with backend and networking engineers to optimize routing, connectivity, and overall system performance.

  • Build internal tooling and automation to improve developer experience and support NetBird's open source ecosystem.

If you read this far and think: "that's me!" - You probably won't need to read any further, and we should have a conversation. But if you doubt the type of experience we expect you to have, the following should help clarify.

 

🔎 What we are looking for

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment, enjoys solving complex networking challenges, and cares deeply about building reliable systems for real users.

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles

  • Strong experience operating production systems on AWS, GCP, or similar

  • Hands-on with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi) and Kubernetes

  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Solid networking fundamentals (IP, routing, NAT, DNS)

  • Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and production incident response

  • Strong sense of ownership - you see problems through from detection to resolution to prevention

  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment and comfortable working independently

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with WireGuard or VPN technologies.

  • Familiarity with peer-to-peer networking and NAT traversal techniques (e.g., STUN, TURN, ICE).

  • Experience operating globally distributed systems with low-latency requirements.

  • Experience with gRPC and REST-based services.

  • Background in security best practices for networked systems.

  • Contributions to open source projects.

  • Experience supporting or interacting with developer communities via GitHub or similar platforms.

  • Experience optimizing infrastructure for cost and performance at scale.

 

😌 What’s in for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That’s why we offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation package: Receive a competitive base salary and equity incentives.

  • Hybrid work environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working both from our centrally located Berlin office and remotely.

  • Diverse and collaborative team: Join a team that values fast, clean shipping and works together to achieve great results.

  • High level of independence: This is not a strict 9-to-6 role. We focus on outcomes, not the appearance of work.

  • Growth opportunities: Be part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of the Zero Trust security revolution.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Software Engineer Backend at NetBird, you will play a key role in building and scaling the backend of our open source, peer-to-peer networking platform. You'll work on high-throughput distributed systems that power secure connectivity for users and organizations around the world.

This role sits at the core of our engineering team. You'll collaborate closely with other engineers to design robust backend services, optimize data systems, and shape the reliability and scalability of NetBird's platform.

What you will do

  • Design, build, and scale high-throughput backend services and APIs in Go that power NetBird's globally distributed networking platform.

  • Own data modeling and database performance optimization — design schemas, optimize queries, and ensure our systems scale under load.

  • Implement observability best practices (metrics, logs, tracing) and contribute to incident response and postmortems.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of features: from design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

  • Collaborate with networking and platform engineers on routing, connectivity, and overall system performance.

  • Engage with the open source community — debug user-reported issues, participate in GitHub discussions, and care about the quality of your work.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of professional experience building backend systems in Go or similar systems languages.

  • Proven experience building and operating high-scale distributed systems (e.g. high-throughput APIs, real-time platforms, or infrastructure tools).

  • Strong in data modeling and database performance optimization: schema design, indexing, query tuning, scaling databases under load.

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts (IP, routing, auth protocols like OAuth2/OIDC).

  • End-to-end ownership mindset: design, implement, deploy, monitor, iterate.

  • Thrives in high-autonomy, fast-paced environments. Comfortable working independently and proactively solving problems.

  • Experience in startup or scale-up environments where speed, ownership, and collaboration are key.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with WireGuard, VPNs, or peer-to-peer networking technologies (STUN, TURN, ICE, NAT traversal).

  • Background in security-focused systems or networking products.

  • Experience with gRPC and REST-based APIs.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes.

  • Open source contributions, especially in Go or networking/infrastructure projects.

What we offer

  • Comprehensive compensation package including a competitive salary and equity incentives.

  • Exceptional growth opportunity as a part of a rapidly growing company at the forefront of the Zero Trust security revolution.

  • Meaningful ownership & space to build an extraordinary product.

  • Intense and energizing atmosphere in our Berlin office (4 days office / 1 day flexible).

  • An outstanding team that has the ambition and drive to build an excellent product and company.

As a Strategy & Operations Intern at NetBird, you'll work directly with the founding team on important strategic and operational topics of the company. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you'll help execute across human resources, growth, partnerships, and operations.

You'll get a front-row seat to how a fast-growing open source startup is built, from early-stage strategy to day-to-day execution, and you'll play an active role in shaping how NetBird scales.

Specifically, you will:

  • Support the founders with strategic projects across growth, product, and operations.

  • Analyze data and create reports to help inform key business and product decisions.

  • Support our recruiting and HR operations, from sourcing and coordinating interviews to keeping our candidate pipeline running.

  • Research markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and risks.

  • Help coordinate and execute cross-team initiatives, ensuring alignment between Product, Growth, and Engineering.

  • Take ownership of ad-hoc projects that matter most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to improving internal processes.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for an exceptional student: highly motivated, analytical, and hands-on, with the ambition to learn how to build and scale a tech startup from the inside.

Must-Haves

  • You're currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • A track record of excellence, for example through top academic results or first internships in startups, consulting, VC, or banking.

  • You're based in Berlin (or able to relocate) and available to work full-time for at least 4 months.

  • You're highly structured, organized, and able to manage multiple topics in parallel.

  • You enjoy working with data, building models, and turning insights into action.

  • You're proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.

  • You have strong written and verbal English skills and can communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves

  • You've already built or led something yourself, whether a side project, a student initiative, or a small venture, and you can show what came of it.

  • Genuine curiosity for open source, developer tools, and how technical products work under the hood.

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Real impact: You'll work on projects that directly influence NetBird's trajectory.

  • Direct exposure to founders: Learn how real startup decisions are made from strategy to execution.

  • Steep learning curve: Gain hands-on experience across product, growth, and operations.

  • Career opportunities: Outstanding interns may have the chance to transition into a permanent role.

  • Hybrid work setup: Work from our centrally located Berlin office while enjoying some flexibility for remote days.

  • Perks: Enjoy team lunches, events, and access to health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

  • Help grow the team, from coordinating our recruiting process to helping win exceptional people for NetBird

  • Support cross-team initiatives and help keep Product, Growth, and Engineering aligned on key company milestones

  • Help design and improve the internal processes that keep a scaling company running, and jump on whatever matters most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to supporting the founders day to day

  • You're highly structured, organized, and able to drive multiple topics in parallel without losing your eye for detail

  • You enjoy working with data, building models, and turning insights into action, but also have a hands-on mentality

  • You're comfortable taking a vague problem, defining it, and driving it to a result

  • Close collaboration with our co-founders: work with them day to day and learn how a startup is really built

  • High impact: your projects directly shape NetBird's trajectory

  • Hybrid setup: a centrally located Berlin office with flexibility for remote days

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass), and dinner on us when you're working late

✏️ What you will do

In Talent Acquisition at NetBird, you'll own how we find and win the people who build NetBird. We're growing fast, with lots of roles to fill across Engineering, GTM and Operations. Today our founders and hiring managers run most of the process themselves. You'll take that over end to end, from the first conversation to a signed offer, and build the hiring engine we need as we scale. You'll work closely with our Chief of Staff and every team lead.

You will:

  • Own full-cycle hiring across Engineering, GTM and Operations, from role kickoff to offer and close.

  • Source proactively for hard technical roles (Go, networking, platform, security), through GitHub, the open source community, events and your own network, instead of waiting for inbound.

  • Run the first conversation with candidates and be the person they trust throughout the process.

  • Partner with hiring managers to sharpen role definitions, scorecards and interview loops, and help interviewers give clear, consistent feedback.

  • Own job postings, interview plans, pipeline hygiene and reporting, so everyone knows where each role stands.

  • Track what matters, from time to hire and pipeline conversion to offer acceptance, and use it to fix what's slowing us down.

  • Turn our open source presence into an employer brand that makes great people want to talk to us.

  • Run offers and closing together with the founders, and hand new hires over smoothly to onboarding.

This is a hands-on role in a small team. You'll run searches yourself, and you'll shape how hiring works at NetBird as we grow.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for a recruiter who can hold their own in a conversation with a senior engineer, likes structure, and gets energy from closing great candidates. Many of the best recruiters we know learned the craft at a recruiting agency or in a fast-growing startup, and if that's you, we'd especially love to hear from you. Agency experience counts as much as in-house: we care about how well you source, assess and close, not where you did it.

Must-Haves

  • 2 to 5 years of full-cycle recruiting experience with a strong share of technical roles, at a recruiting agency or in-house at a startup or scale-up.

  • A track record of sourcing and hiring software engineers, ideally for backend, infrastructure or security roles.

  • Enough technical curiosity to understand what our teams build and to tell a strong engineering profile from a keyword match.

  • You work with data and use it to improve the process, not just report on it.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. You write outreach people actually answer.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools every day, for example to source, screen or draft outreach, and you know where they help and where they don't.

  • Comfortable in a fast-growing team where processes are still being built.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience hiring for open source, developer tools, infrastructure or security companies.

  • Experience hiring GTM roles such as Sales, Solutions Engineering or DevRel.

  • Experience hiring across Europe, including relocation to Berlin.

  • Experience building an employer brand or a talent community from scratch.

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: Small team, real scope. You own each role until the right person signs, and you fix the process instead of working around it.

  • Default to candor: Direct, kind, and specific, with candidates, hiring managers and founders alike. You say no early and explain why.

  • Stay close to the user: You take the time to understand our product and the community behind it, so you can explain to candidates why NetBird matters.

😌 What's in it for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive compensation including salary and equity.

  • Hybrid Cowork model in our new Berlin office with flexibility for remote days.

  • Build the function and grow with it: You set up how NetBird hires, with real ownership from day one and room to grow into a lead role as the team scales.

  • Close collaboration with our founders and every team lead.

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, and health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass).

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing a zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open-source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As a Technical Product Owner at NetBird, you'll be the link between our users and our engineering team on the core NetBird platform. That means the clients, the dashboard and API, and the self-hosted setup. Today our CTO covers product next to running engineering, and you'll take over a big part of the day to day. You keep the backlog in Linear in good shape, turn feedback from customers and the community into clear, well-scoped work and make sure engineers can spend their time building. You'll report to our CTO and work closely with engineering, support and sales.

You will:

  • Own the day-to-day backlog in Linear. Triage incoming issues, write clear tickets with context and acceptance criteria and keep priorities current.

  • Build a simple system for collecting feedback from customers, GitHub issues, community channels, support and sales calls, and turn it into well-framed problems the team can act on.

  • Talk to users and customers directly to understand their setups and the problem behind each request.

  • Plan our regular cycles with engineering, break bigger features into shippable pieces, and follow them through to release.

  • Keep the rest of the company in the loop on what's shipping, from release notes and changelogs to updates for sales and support.

  • Close the loop with the people who gave feedback, so they know what happened with it.

  • Spot patterns across feedback and bring them into roadmap discussions, backed by data where you can.

This is a technical product owner role. You won't write production code, but unlike a classic product owner you'll go deep with engineers on how things work, reproduce issues yourself and judge how much effort a request really takes. It's also a hands-on role in a small team. There's no big product org around you yet, so you'll help shape how product work runs at NetBird as we grow.

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for someone who is at home in technical conversations, both with our engineers and with our users, who mostly work in IT and infrastructure teams. You also like structure and keep a busy backlog in order.

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role at a (technical) B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or developer tools company.

  • A technical background. You're comfortable reading API docs, following a GitHub discussion, and digging into how something works together with engineers.

  • Understanding of networking basics like IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and VPNs.

  • Hands-on experience running a backlog in Linear, Jira, or similar, and writing tickets engineers can pick up without a follow-up meeting.

  • Experience working directly with customers or users and turning their feedback into prioritized work.

  • Good judgment on priorities. You can say no, explain why, and keep people aligned.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. You default to writing things down.

  • You work AI native. You use AI tools and coding agents every day, for example to sort feedback, dig into a problem or draft tickets, and you know where they help and where they don't.

  • Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where processes are still being built.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with networking, security, or zero trust products.

  • Experience with open source projects or developer communities.

  • Experience building CLI products.

  • Hands-on experience with self-hosting, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Some coding experience, enough to read a PR or reproduce a bug yourself.

  • Experience using product analytics to back up decisions.

😌 What’s in it for you

We want you to do meaningful work and be proud of what you build.

That’s why we offer:

  • Comprehensive compensation package: Receive a competitive base salary and equity incentives.

  • Hybrid work environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working both from our centrally located Berlin office and remotely.

  • Real product ownership: A direct say in what our engineering team builds next.

  • Open source impact: Work in the open on a popular open source project, in direct contact with our customers and community.

  • Growth opportunities: The chance to build up our product team from the start, with room to grow as NetBird scales.

If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. And if you have time, try NetBird first and tell us in your application one thing you'd change.
